scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:vps: npm --prefix backend ci --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend ci --include=dev && npm run build && npm --prefix backend prune --omit=dev
scripts.host: npm run build:vps && npx pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs --env production
scripts.heroku-postbuild: npm --prefix backend ci --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend ci --include=dev && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend prune --omit=dev && rm -rf frontend/node_modules
